reviews.x: I'VE WORN THIS FRANGRANCE FOR MORE THAN 45 YEARS. IT'S THE FIRST PERFUME I WORE WHEN MY HIUSBAND AND I WERE DATING IN 1975. HE ALWAYS SAYS IT SMELLS LIKE FRESH AIR AND SUNSHINE. CAN'T FIND IT ANYWHERE BUT AMAZON. WAY TO GO AMAZON! ALWAYS MY GO TO PLACE!

reviews.t: Wind Song Bpody Spray - Pack of 3
reviews.x: Wind Song is a favorite fragrance I have used for many  years and I still  very much like wearing it.  For awhile I couldn't find it in the local stores and was quite happy to see it here at Amazon.  This particular body spray is not heavy or strong but lightly scented and is great for everyday wear.

I was so happy to come upon Wind Song recently - a scent I wore back when I was a teen and then in my early 20s and I'm now in my early 60s.  I loved it then and I love it now!  A simple yet unique scent for this body spray (that's what I used back in the day and it's what I bought again.  I feel that this scent lingers for quite some time.  In my opinion, you can't go wrong with this scent!

My cheapie thrill perfume that comforts me and reminds me of home. Powdery, classic, I love it. Been using since high school and I don't care what anyone thinks, I use $350 a bottle perfumes and this!!! :)

reviews.t: Smells good but not as great as I remember and they are smal...
reviews.x: I didn't read the description on the sizes as good as I should have. These are pretty small so I don't consider this a good price. I would have if they had been the larger sizes I used to see in the stores. This looks like the $1.99 size. I like the smell but for some reason,  it's not as intoxicating and fresh as I remember. Either the formula has changed, I've  changed, or I should have sprung for the perfume instead of the body spray. I'm wearing it but not loving it as much as I thought...an

i love this clean and delightful scent. The store that usually carries this body spray has stopped carrying it, much to my disappointment. i was delighted to see that Amazon has it. i saw the three cans and immediately snatched them up. They arrived so fast. Happy day!! This is one of the reasons i love Amazon. Thank you.

After my grandmother passed away my grandfather told us kids how she wore this perfume when they first met and he wished he could smell it again. I was happy to see Amazon sold this. My grandfather said it smelled exactly like grandma used to. He loved it. Thank you for giving us this opportunity ❤

daughter asked me  what I was wearing. and I told her this body spray WIND SONG..  smells sooooooooooo  good and NOT overwhelming.  She is a young lady, so not really into "perfumes, but she loves this

I used to buy this fragrance very often in the 70s and as soon as I opened my recent purchase of this body spray Wind Song…I knew right away as soon as I sprayed it..was not the original scent. Very disappointed.. I will try my luck with the ‘original’ Wind Song perfume that I see as advertised on Amazon. You never know if you’re getting a fake or a real anything these days! But the scent is definitely off in this body spray set and definitely NOT the original fragrance from the 70’s.
This has been my favorite fragrance for more years than I can count but is extremely difficult to find. Thanks for offering it - I will continue to order.

Wind Song perfume is way too strong and sort of "cheap" smelling but these give you a fresh springlike flowery smell without being too sicky-sweet or strong.  You can spray it on your clothes and it doesn't stain, but the freshness stays with the clothes (but not in a strong, overpowering way).  With my body's chemical makeup it smells like Nina Ricci on me, so that's great!

I love the fragrance and was pleased that it was still available after all these years. The body spray has a lighter fragrance which is to be expected. Even when I spray it all over and I'm practically choking on the fragrance, it fades very quickly and no one else around me can smell it unless I put my arm under their noses.

reviews.t: The scent is all it claims to be
reviews.x: I tried this product with no background experience.  It totally met all my expectations.  The scent lived up to the title, not too full, soft, but lingering.  It is really hard to describe, but I would say  a light, spray that will stay with you but not in any way overpower or mask.  This is a product I will buy again.

This does Not smell like the original scent AT ALL and whatever it is the scent doesn't last its not the original will never buy again its more alcohol then anything else it evaporate just like the cheap knock off stuff you find in the dollar stores Burlington Ross and all stores like them do not waste your money!!!

This is not the same smell/fragrance as the Wind Song I am use to buying.  I have been using this fragrance for years and I know how it REALLY smells. It is in the same package but definitely not the same fragrance. I will have to go into the local store to purchase.  I will not be buying this off Amazon again.

Wind Song Body Spray was actually ordered for an older relative. She was very pleased to receive it so quickly. It was packaged really well and she was happy to receive the package of 3.  She loves this scent so much and having the three allows her to use it often without fear of running out.

Wind Song has been around since the 50's. I first smelled it when my sister bought some in her teens, we are now 77 and 75 and I still love it. I get so many complements  when I wear it. I even had a gentleman in Wal Marts stop had ask me about it.

This is a fabulous scent Yet beware--it's strong ....use very little spray on your body !!!! My husband uses it after his bathroom visits...it's super smell coverage Yet can be used lightly on your body or a room spray freshener!!!!!
I love that it came as a three pack! I was thrilled when I came across this product. I had used this product for many years and have loved it for that long! So happy to have found it again!!
My dear Mom wore Wind Song perfume and everytime I use it I think of her. I use it as an all over body spray and deodorant. Works great and has a long lasting scent. Very refreshing!!

claims.text: Many reviewers describe the scent as light, fresh, and not overpowering, suitable for everyday wear.
Several reviewers have used this fragrance for decades and are glad to find it available on Amazon after local stores stopped carrying it.
Some reviewers say the scent is not the original and does not last, with complaints about it fading quickly or smelling like alcohol.
A few reviewers note the bottles are small and not a good value for the price.
Some reviewers share nostalgic personal memories tied to the fragrance, including family connections.
